title: Bugatti Structured Two Tone Quarter Zip Jumper
description: The Bugatti Structured Two Tone Jumper is a smart-casual knit with modern appeal. Designed in a regular fit, it’s crafted with a two-tone textured knit that adds depth and subtle contrast to your look. Featuring a quarter zip neckline with a sleek zip pull, this jumper is versatile enough to wear layered over a shirt for a polished style or on its own for a relaxed weekend look. Ribbed cuffs and hem ensure a comfortable fit, while the Bugatti branding adds a refined finishing touch. Regular Fit - traditional cut, fits looser around the body.
